== June 2017 source and chronology ==
The actual composed lower cutout from [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]], PDF page 13, prints <code>E</code>. The cover directs using it with the original physical card, so only uncovered original upper fields are inherited from [[:File:ANH-D-conquest-hires.webp]]. The source cover gives text as of June 1, 2017; the precise first publication day is not established. Later full-face repository dates are first located records. The source order is 2017 partial, first located 2018 full face marked E, then later full face marked D-E1. Current <code>2_152</code> remains with the latest full face; no historical executable ID is invented. The actual 1998 Glossary, page 39, already records these replacement words: [[:File:ANH-D-Conquest-Decipher-Glossary-1998-p39-entry.png]].
